race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
race.verdict: DESERT ROMANCE is yet to live up to her illustrious pedigree but there's been obvious signs of ability on both starts and switched to all-weather, she can get on the up. Threelittleangels should be a factor again, with Tootgarook perhaps the pick of the debutantes. DESERT ROMANCE THREELITTLEANGELS (IRE) TOOTGAROOK (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Desert Romance (2/1), Tootgarook (9/2), Threelittleangels (5/1), Diamond Blue Point (13/2), Aloisi Star (7/1), Persian Coast (10/1), Kirton Angel (12/1), Ruby Punch (14/1), Letter To Hermione (25/1), Mystical Magical (33/1), Milkin It (66/1), Kissamee (100/1), Peacock's Way (100/1)
